name: project-state
description: Turn any multi-stakeholder project into a system where routine reporting is a byproduct of normal work. Skills for milestones, objectives and KPIs, phase gates, documents, status reports, feedback and funder compliance, shaped by swappable packs and capability plugins: SR&ED, Tender, Intel, Portfolio and Research. Ships a local project-state server, so Claude reads and writes your project's state through checked, attributed tools.
